final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(1.0 * rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS average_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_rate_per_day) AS overall_mean FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.average_rate_per_day, r.average_rate_per_day - o.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND r.average_rate_per_day > o.overall_mean ORDER BY r.rating
